_meta.purpose: Unit-economics structure for Module A, confirmed with Lucas 2026-07-21. Model is % of TOTAL REVENUE, where total revenue = product net sales (after discounts) + freight revenue.
_meta.status: CONFIRMED 2026-07-21 EXCEPT delivery costs. Freight + fulfillment are UNDER REVISION: GE is moving to a new fulfiller and delivery economics are being rebuilt in a separate session. BEFORE ANY MARGIN ANALYSIS, ASK LUCAS to confirm the current freight_cost_pct + fulfillment_pct + freight_revenue_pct. Do not run margin numbers on the values below until he confirms.
_meta.basis: total_revenue = product_net + freight_revenue; freight_revenue = freight_revenue_pct * product_net. All cost rates are % of total_revenue. COGS comes per-SKU from cost-basis.json scaled by cogs_calibration_factor so the aggregate matches cogs_target_pct.

_profit_floor_note: Hard guardrail: minimum 10% NET profit on every sale, per-purchase, AFTER paid media (% of total revenue).
_freight_revenue_note: Freight billed to customer, averaged across subsidized + non-subsidized deliveries, as % of PRODUCT revenue. Free-ship threshold R$299. Added on top of product to form total revenue; not double-counted (product AOV excludes freight).
_cogs_note: Real COGS ~22% of total revenue (Lucas). Bottom-up per-SKU cost-basis.json totals only ~16% (the B2B 'preco minimo' study excludes inbound freight/duty/breakage), so the engine scales each per-SKU cost by cogs_calibration_factor (=0.22 x total_rev / raw per-SKU COGS, computed on the 2026-06-21..07-21 window). Preserves relative product differences, fixes the absolute level. Replace with real per-SKU costs when available.
_tax_note: Effective tax on total revenue. Confirmed ~12%.
_freight_cost_note: UNDER REVISION (2026-07-21) - new fulfiller incoming; delivery economics being rebuilt in a separate session. ~17% was the CURRENT fulfiller. ASK LUCAS before using for margin analysis.
_fulfillment_note: UNDER REVISION (2026-07-21) - moves with freight under the new fulfiller. ~3% was the CURRENT fulfiller. ASK LUCAS before using for margin analysis.
_media_note: Paid media allocated per order at the channel level in the Module A v1 media layer. The 10% floor is checked AFTER media allocation.
